string ::= "\"" ([^"\\] | "\\" (["\\/bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F] [0-9a-fA-F] [0-9a-fA-F] [0-9a-fA-F]))* "\"" ws
ws ::= [ \t\n\r]*

natural.prompt_template:

triggered_tail.prompt_template:

ws ::= [ \t\n\r]*
